scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills for this repo. It already has a change-control skill that covers our PR route, and the review threads show no new corrections there. What happens to change control? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A lens with no verified friction gets no skill. Reuse or compose the existing skill instead of authoring a duplicate.

scenarios.input: Build this repo's skill library. Copilot sessions exist, but the Codex and Gemini stores are not on this machine and skillopt is not installed. How do you report session coverage? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Missing retrieval is reported as unavailable evidence, never as absence of history, and no store location is invented.

scenarios.desc: Output name collides with an existing skill
scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills. The plan proposes snafu-change-control, but .claude/skills/snafu-change-control already exists and the user did not authorize changing it. What do you do? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The plan subcommand exits 1 on a conflict. The run renames, gets authorization for --update, or drops the skill.

scenarios.desc: GitHub source with Azure DevOps pipelines and Boards
scenarios.input: Capture project workflow knowledge. Source and PRs are on GitHub, required checks run in Azure Pipelines, and work items live in Azure Boards. How should the workflow route a blocked PR? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Hosting roles resolve independently. A GitHub-merged PR is blocked by required check contexts matched to the evaluated revision, even when Azure Pipelines runs the check.

scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills. Agents rediscover the Azure DevOps project GUID, repository GUID, and build definition ID on every task. What goes into the workflow skill? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Stable verified IDs live beside the instruction with their scope and type. Run IDs and active iterations stay in task context.

scenarios.desc: Optimization requested without a scored eval
scenarios.input: Build this repo's skill library and optimize every new skill with skillopt. We have no scored eval set. Context-optimizer has not run yet. What order and outcome? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: context-optimizer runs first. Without a frozen, scored, held-out evaluation, skillopt is reported as NOT RUN, never invented.

scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills. Agents write 'blocked by #812' in the work item description and assume the dependency exists. What should the workflow require? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A text mention creates no stored link. The workflow names the relationship direction, API form, and read-back check.

scenarios.desc: Installing the skill is not a request to run it
scenarios.input: I just installed the project-toolkit plugin, which includes skill-bootstrap. Should anything run now? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Installation starts no bootstrap campaign and generates no library. Only an explicit request starts a run.

scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills. Agents keep copying the release steps and the current version number into notes, and they confuse publishing with deploying. What should the release workflow skill do? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Route to the repository-owned release guide and executable definition, separate build, promote, publish, deploy, and adoption, and keep version numbers out of durable skill text.

scenarios.input: Build this repo's skill library, and also keep a friction ledger file that records every correction we found. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The skill creates no ledger, registry, or per-fact database. A lesson lands in the workflow skill that changes the next action, with a source reference.

scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills for a repo where every SKILL.md under .claude/skills is generated from templates/skills and a build overwrites hand edits. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Writing generated copies breaks the canonical source rule, and writing templates breaks the declared boundary. The run stops and asks the user to authorize the canonical paths or accept proposals only.

scenarios.desc: Discovery item is computable from repository state
scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills for this repo. Discovery verified two items: (a) why generated mirrors under src/ must never be hand-edited, and (b) a mapping from each changed path to the CI gates it triggers, which today lives as a prose table. How should each item become part of the skill library? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Each verified item is sorted by tool form. Rationale the model reasons with stays prose (scaffold). An answer a program can compute from repository state ships as a deterministic script (instrument), with prose only for why.

scenarios.desc: Draft skill asks the model to compute by hand
scenarios.input: skillforge returned a draft workflow skill that tells the agent, in prose, to count each skill's description characters and compare them with the limits in scripts/skill_description_budget.json. Accept the draft as is? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Every computable claim ships with a script. Prose that asks the model to recompute a deterministic answer is sent back for a script, and the prose keeps only the reasoning a script cannot carry.

scenarios.desc: No held-out eval exists after authoring
scenarios.input: Bootstrap authored two workflow skills. No scored held-out evaluation exists for them. What does the run do about measuring whether the skills help? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The run builds the eval itself: mined corrections become frozen cases, each skill is scored with the skill against a no-skill baseline, and the report gives the capability delta. UNMEASURED is the exception, not the default.

scenarios.desc: A generated skill cites a path that moved
scenarios.input: Three months after a bootstrap run, a generated skill still tells agents to run tests/build_scripts/test_copilot_dispatcher_artifact.py, which was deleted. How should the library catch and handle this? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Each generated skill carries machine-checkable provenance. A drift check runs every skill's re-verification checks and names the failing skills, which go back through the run with --update.

scenarios.desc: Knowledge transfer with no friction record
scenarios.input: The maintainer is leaving and wants the project's domain theory and architecture rationale captured for smaller models. Session history shows no agent corrections in those areas. Does skill-bootstrap produce skills for them? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Knowledge mode gates by the taxonomy instead of friction: a lens gets a skill when verified content exists and a frozen baseline probe shows a model without the skill gets it wrong. There is still no quota.

scenarios.input: Bootstrap skills for this repo. The user has no candidate outcomes in mind. How do you find candidate cases to build workflows from? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Candidate selection runs as a deterministic mining step over git history (reverts, churn and TODO hotspots, optional PR review rounds) that ranks cases with evidence, instead of the model browsing history by hand.
